title: EventBus multi-callback registry mutation recovery contract

contract.multi_callback_mutation_isolation: Multiple callbacks may mutate the listener registry during one broadcast without aborting EventBus.emit()
contract.current_cycle_snapshot: The active broadcast follows its listener snapshot and is not corrupted by concurrent registry mutation
contract.current_cycle_add_isolation: A listener added during an active broadcast does not receive that same broadcast
contract.current_cycle_remove_continuity: A listener removed during an active broadcast still receives that broadcast exactly once when present in the active snapshot
contract.post_mutation_continuity: Subsequent broadcasts operate against the updated listener registry
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after multiple callback-driven mutations
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Callback-driven additions and removals do not create duplicate owner entries
contract.delivery_once: Each applicable listener receives each broadcast exactly once
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful across multiple mutation cycles
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
